Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: Ilvwm.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 40 s. 2023 MAY 17 2023 HON. CHARLES MERVIN M. CAPISTRANO Sangguniang Kabataan Chairperson Barangay Pag-asa, Obando Province of Bulacan Dear SK Chairperson Capistrano: We write regarding your letter dated January 13, 2023 requesting for clarification regarding filling up of vacancies in the positions of President and Vice President in the Pambayang Pederasyon ng mga Sangguniang Kabataan (SK) in the Municipality of Obando, Province of Bulacan. Based on your representation, the SK Pederasyon President of that municipality won in the 2022 National and Local Elections while the Pederasyon Vice-President won during the 2019 Midterm Elections leaving the two positions vacant. It is your position that Memorandum Circular No. 2022-1301, which adopted the DILG Legal Opinion No. 63 s. 2022, will not apply in the herein situation because of the absence of Internal Rules of Procedure adopted by the SK Pederasyon of Obando. With all due respect, we beg to disagree. Foremost, let us invite you to revisit the pertinent provisions of DILG-COMELEC-NYC JMC No. 2017-012 which requires SK Pederasyon at all levels to formulate and adopt it own Internal Rules of Procedure, viz: V. POWERS AND FUNCTIONS Section 23. POWERS AND FUNCTIONS OF THE PEDERASYO - The Panlalawigang, Panlungsod and Pamabayang Pederasyon shall have the following functions: xxx 1 Manner of Filling Up of Vacancy in the Barangay, Sangguniang Kabataan (SK), Liga ng mga Barangay and Pederasyon ng mga SK Due to the Assumption to Higher Position/Office of BSKOs who won in the May 09, 2022 National and Local Elections. 2 Guidelines on the Conduct of SK Pederasyon Elections, and Rules Governing Terms of Office, Suspension and Removal of all SK Pederasyon Officers "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

2. Formulate and adopt its own Internal Rules of Procedure (IRP) which shall prescribe a set of rules to serve as guidelines of the Pederasyon Officers and the Committees in the discharge of their official functions, duties and responsibilities, particularly on internal organization, date, time and venue of regular or special session or meeting; parliamentary procedures; payment of Pederasyon dues and such other rules and regulations that are not contrary to existing laws, ordinance this JMC and other government issuances; xxx It may be well to note that the DILG has issued Advisory dated May 23, 2018 requiring all SK Chairpersons to attend and complete the scheduled orientation. Failure to complete the orientation/briefing shall bar the concerned SK to participate in the SK Pederasyon Election at all levels. The said SK Pederasyon orientation was focused on the discussion of the powers and functions of the Pederasyon, with emphasis on the formulation of the Pederasyon's IRP. Therefore, the Pederasyon Officers are fully aware of the importance of the IRP as it will govern their internal operation and in the discharge of their official functions. Thus, we are now in quandary on how the Pederasyon ng mga SK of Obando operates in the absence of their IRP. At this point, there is an urgent need for the SK Pederasyon of Obando to formulate their IRP for them to address this pressing issue on vacancies and in compliance with Sections 23 and 27 of JMC 2017-01. It may be worthy to stress that failure to adopt their IRP may be a ground for a disciplinary action, suspension or removal from office of Pederasyon Officers pursuant to Section 31 of the JMC, thus: VII. POWERS AND FUNCTIONS SECTION 31. GROUNDS FOR DISCIPLINARY ACTIONS a. Any SK Pederasyon Officer may be disciplined, suspended, or removed from office, after due notice and hearing, on any of the following grounds xxx 3. Failure to perform official duties and functions as Pederasyon Officer; xxx Henceforth, we stand consistent with our position in DILG Legal Opinion No. 63 s. 2022 where the Department had the occasion to resolve that concurrent vacancies in offices of President and Vice President of the Pederasyon shall be governed by their Internal Rules of Procedure of the concerned SK Pederasyon. This opinion is rendered based solely on the facts presented and our appreciation of the same without prejudice to any contrary opinion, decisions, and orders of other government agencies and the courts. Page 2 of 3

We hope to have guided you on the matter. Thank you very much. Very truly yours, BYA ORITY OF THE SECRETARY N V CTOR R. LLAMAS TTY Under cretary for External, Legal and Legislative Affairs LLLS/RPB/LRALLD/jVPW copy furnished: DIR.
